newsitem.title: INDIA: India ICICI sets short-term prime rate at 12.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: India ICICI sets short-term prime rate at 12.5 pct.

text.p: The Industrial Credit and Investment Corporation of India (ICICI) said it has revised its lending rate structure and introduced a new prime rate for short-term loans with maturity up to 12 months.
In a statement released late on Wednesday, term-lender ICICI said its short-term prime rate will be 12.50 percent per annum.
The revised rate structure takes effect from July 24.

Earlier ICICI had a two-tier interest rate structure, with a medium-term prime rate of 13 percent per annum for loans with maturities up to 30 months and a long-term prime rate of 14.5 percent for other loans.
There is no change in these two rates, ICICI said.
The short-term prime rate will be the benchmark for pricing of floating rate loans where interest rates are reset annually, ICICI said.
